findings.claim: The new DBUnit dataset is referenced by a bare filename and therefore sits at the root of web/src/test/resources; it is the only dataset in the repository not under a package-mirroring path (org/openmrs/.../include/), and because the web module publishes a -tests.jar that bare name also lands at the root of a downstream classpath.
findings.evidence: At d381957e84386f5902bec7886b8f2ba391dc5101. (1) Placement: scanned every *.xml under any */src/test/resources for a <dataset> root element -- exactly 1 at a resources root (the new web/src/test/resources/OpenmrsFilterTest-initial.xml) vs 122 under package subdirectories; the 122 is the positive control that the same pipeline does find pre-existing datasets. `ls api/src/test/resources/*.xml` returns only TestingApplicationContext.xml and log4j2.xml, and web/src/test/resources root holds only log4j2.xml and AltAuthSchemeTestingApplicationContext.xml -- both classpath-root-by-necessity (log4j2 auto-discovery; BaseWebContextSensitiveTest.java:24-25 loads the latter as `classpath*:AltAuthSchemeTestingApplicationContext.xml`). A DBUnit dataset has no such necessity: executeDataSet(String) resolves with getClass().getClassLoader().getResourceAsStream (BaseContextSensitiveNonTransactionalTest.java:703), so any package path works. (2) Reference convention: every dataset constant in the tree carries the package path, e.g. ObsServiceTest.java `protected static final String INITIAL_OBS_XML = "org/openmrs/api/include/ObsServiceTest-initial.xml"` (the exact naming twin of this file, path-qualified), and even the base class's own constants are `org/openmrs/include/initialInMemoryTestDataSet.xml` / `org/openmrs/include/standardTestDataset.xml` (BaseContextSensitiveNonTransactionalTest.java:128,130). The only other executeDataSet in the web module, web/src/test/java/org/openmrs/web/filter/update/UpdateFilterTest.java:45, is `executeDataSet("org/openmrs/api/include/UserServiceTest.xml")`. (3) Downstream reach: maven-help-plugin effective-pom for `-pl web` shows maven-jar-plugin bound with goals ['jar','test-jar'] in the effective build/plugins (not merely pluginManagement) and a single unfiltered <testResource> of web/src/test/resources; web/target/test-classes/OpenmrsFilterTest-initial.xml confirms the file lands at the root of what becomes openmrs-web-3.0.0-SNAPSHOT-tests.jar, and test-suite/module/omod/pom.xml:70-72 depends on openmrs-web with <type>test-jar</type>. (4) History: within the shallow 410-commit window the only genuine new-dataset commit is 50b9990322 (TRUNK-6734, #6400) adding api/src/test/resources/org/openmrs/api/include/PatientServiceTest-identifiers.xml -- package-qualified. CONTRIBUTING.md step 5 states the rule the project holds itself to: 'Adhere to common conventions you see in the existing code'. Recommended fix: move to web/src/test/resources/org/openmrs/web/filter/include/OpenmrsFilterTest-initial.xml and make the constant the full path.

findings.claim: The per-class `@AfterEach public void logout() { Context.logout(); }` duplicates teardown the base class already performs, and no other test class in the repository declares one.
findings.evidence: BaseContextSensitiveNonTransactionalTest.java:992-1001 already declares `@AfterEach public void clearSessionAfterEachTest()` ending in `if (Context.isSessionOpen()) Context.logout();`, inherited here via BaseWebContextSensitiveTest -> BaseContextSensitiveTest. Context.logout() itself returns early when no session is open (api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/api/context/Context.java:713-716), so the base version already covers every case. Prior-instance search, whole repo: of the 16 .java files containing `Context.logout()` (positive control for the search), only the base class and this new test pair it with an @AfterEach; the third candidate, api/src/test/java/org/openmrs/scheduler/SchedulerServiceIT.java, has an @AfterEach at lines 82-87 that only deletes scheduler tasks -- its 30 Context.logout() calls are all inside test bodies (lines 329+). Falsified empirically: deleted the hook plus its AfterEach import at this sha and ran `mvn -o -pl web test -Dtest=OpenmrsFilterTest` -> 'Tests run: 5, Failures: 0, Errors: 0'; file then restored with `git checkout --` and `git status --porcelain` is clean.

out_of_scope: Test coverage / simplification: the base class already authenticates as admin:test before every test (BaseContextSensitiveNonTransactionalTest.baseSetupWithStandardDataAndAuthentication line 937 -> authenticate() -> getCredentials() = admin/test), so the authenticated tests could assert 'admin' and drop both the new dataset file and the Context.authenticate call entirely; a prior instance of loading a dataset to authenticate a second user does exist (UpdateFilterTest.java:45-47), but there it is justified by needing a non-superuser and here no such reason is stated.

Correctness / performance: the filter no longer calls setAttribute on every request. Containers that replicate sessions (Tomcat DeltaManager and friends) treat setAttribute as the dirty marker, so a clustered deployment now replicates username/locale only on change -- worth someone confirming nothing depended on the per-request write.

Correctness: the comment 'set username as attribute on session so parent servlet container can identify sessions easier' moved inside the `if (user != null)` block (OpenmrsFilter.java:88-89) where it no longer sits next to any setAttribute call.
